posts.title: squishy noses
posts.description: I dedicate this post to Fiona the hippo. Rest in peace, you big sweet potato. I met up with a friend at a coffee shop today. On the side table, among brochures and board games, sat two green stress-ball pigs. One poor piggy had its nose ripped clean off. posts.title: a ten-year snooty-versary
posts.description: Ten years ago today, I celebrated an “independence day” of my own. I was a few weeks into my manatee care internship in Bradenton, FL, working with Snooty the manatee and his tankmates, two rescued manatees preparing to be released. posts.title: nightmare on sassafras hill
posts.description: I’m sure this story will make someone say, “I’ll take things that didn’t happen for 500, Alex.” But it really did happen. At 8 AM on October 31, 2009, my teenage self had an appointment at a now-defunct psychology clinic called Sassafras Hill. And the whole thing felt off . My parents couldn't find the place.
